tracks.exact: Same ISA, expression order and model; array equality is required.
tracks.numeric_equivalent: Same model with bounded floating-point differences; independent oracle required.
tracks.model_change: Separate calibration and clean-reference quality record; never substitutes for correctness.

fixed_group.domain: normalized finite fixtures; threshold ties diagnosed separately
fixed_group.hard_threshold_policy: Only coefficients within the DCT forward error band may choose either adjacent mask; require valid mask weight and reconstruction. Outside the band the independent mask is mandatory.

image.conditional_policy: Only for individually diagnosed rounding or threshold cases with preserved failed arrays; not for wrong candidate or destination identity.
